rationale: HeadlessSurface now rejects Dawn's Null backend because it can return a flat readback while no native GPU driver exists. The guard protects executable pixel proof from treating unavailable hardware as a rendered product frame; native GPU adapters remain unchanged. This crosses the render-assets-and-backends watch family through core/render only, with no Vellum authority move, asset change, or accepted boundary change. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage remains explicit.
tests: AudioInspectorPanel renders a non-empty headless snapshot
